name: unit_allegiance_overrides
title: Unit-level allegiance overrides (data/unit_allegiance_overrides.csv)
description: Hand-maintained, dated. A row says that one unit (a unit_id of data/units.csv) stood on a different side from its nation during a period, for example a formation that served with the other side's forces. It wins over data/nation_allegiance.csv for that unit and those days; outside the rows the nation's side applies. Rows of one unit never overlap. Populated only where the dataset already has a sourced case; the table may be empty. Added 15 November 2026 (roadmap 384, part 2). The conflict is the one of the nation table (WW2).

fields.name: side
fields.description: The side the unit stood on during the period (same vocabulary as data/nation_allegiance.csv).

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, inside WW2 (1 September 1939 to 2 September 1945).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day of the period (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, not before valid_from. Blank = until the end of WW2 for the unit's nation.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: ';'-separated reference ids of data/references_meta.csv; at least one.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the source says (paraphrased) and why the unit's side differs from its nation's.
